summary: Upgrade a managed Kubernetes cluster to a newer version. Kubernetes will be unavailable during cluster upgrades.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: Name of the managed cluster.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --control-plane-only
parameters.help: Upgrade the cluster control plane only. If not specified, both control plane AND all node pools will be upgraded.

parameters.name: --disable-force-upgrade
parameters.help: Disable forceUpgrade cluster upgrade settings override.

parameters.name: --enable-force-upgrade
parameters.help: Enable forceUpgrade cluster upgrade settings override.

parameters.name: --if-match
parameters.help: The value provided will be compared to the ETag of the managed cluster, if it matches the operation will proceed. If it does not match, the request will be rejected to prevent accidental overwrites. This must not be specified when creating a new cluster.

parameters.name: --if-none-match
parameters.help: Set to '*' to allow a new cluster to be created, but to prevent updating an existing cluster. Other values will be ignored.

parameters.name: --k8s-support-plan
parameters.help: Choose from "KubernetesOfficial" or "AKSLongTermSupport", with "AKSLongTermSupport" you get 1 extra year of CVE patchs.

parameters.name: --kubernetes-version
parameters.help: Version of Kubernetes to upgrade the cluster to, such as "1.16.9".

parameters.name: --no-wait
parameters.help: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish.

parameters.name: --node-image-only
parameters.help: Only upgrade node image for agent pools.

parameters.name: --tier
parameters.help: Specify SKU tier for managed clusters. '--tier standard' enables a standard managed cluster service with a financially backed SLA. '--tier free' does not have a financially backed SLA. '--tier premium' is required for '--k8s-support-plan AKSLongTermSupport'.

parameters.name: --upgrade-override-until
parameters.help: Until when the cluster upgradeSettings overrides are effective. It needs to be in a valid date-time format that's within the next 30 days. For example, 2023-04-01T13:00:00Z. Note that if --force-upgrade is set to true and --upgrade-override- until is not set, by default it will be set to 3 days from now.

parameters.name: --yes
parameters.help: Do not prompt for confirmation.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
